hero: In a busy medicine outpatient department of a public hospital in Bulacan, a Filipino internal medicine resident in a white coat sits beside a 52-year-old Filipino jeepney driver and his wife, pointing to a color-coded paper chart on the desk; electric fans, a window with afternoon light, a queue of patients visible through the door; warm and attentive mood; no text in the image.

figures.teaches: CKD risk depends on both the GFR category and the albuminuria category, read together on the KDIGO heat map.
figures.content: A 6-by-3 grid. Rows top to bottom: 'G1 >=90', 'G2 60-89', 'G3a 45-59', 'G3b 30-44', 'G4 15-29', 'G5 <15' (mL/min/1.73 m2). Columns left to right: 'A1 <30 mg/g', 'A2 30-300 mg/g', 'A3 >300 mg/g'. Colors: G1-G2/A1 green; G1-G2/A2 yellow; G1-G2/A3 orange; G3a/A1 yellow; G3a/A2 orange; G3a/A3 red; G3b/A1 orange; G3b/A2 red; G3b/A3 red; G4 all red; G5 all red. A small marker 'Example: G3b A3' in the G3b/A3 cell. Legend: green 'low risk (if other markers of damage, CKD)', yellow 'moderately increased', orange 'high', red 'very high'. Footer: 'CKD = abnormality >3 months. Write Cause + G + A. Source: KDIGO 2024'.

figures.teaches: KFRE results map to specific clinic actions, in addition to eGFR and ACR criteria.
figures.content: A vertical ladder with four rungs, colored from pale to deep teal. Rung 1: '5-year risk <3%' -> 'Usually primary care; eGFR + ACR at least yearly'. Rung 2: '5-year risk 3-5% or more' -> 'Refer to nephrology'. Rung 3: '2-year risk >10%' -> 'Multidisciplinary CKD care: dietitian, educator, pharmacist, social worker'. Rung 4: '2-year risk >40%' -> 'Modality education, vascular access planning, transplant referral'. Side box: 'Inputs (4-variable KFRE): age, sex, eGFR, ACR'. Footer note: 'Validated in 721,357 people, 31 cohorts; may overestimate outside North America. KDIGO 2024 practice points.'

card: A doctor's hand pointing at a color-coded kidney risk grid on a clinic desk, a urine sample cup and a blood pressure cuff beside it, no text.
